name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
summary: A notice announces that Taskmaster Scrange wants some capable hands to cull the competition in the Searing Gorge. The work is slaying Dark Iron Taskmasters and Dark Iron Slavers until your clothes are bloody enough, then returning to Scrange.

sections.title: An Open Position
sections.body: Scrange wants applicants to head out through the gorge and slaughter the Dark Iron Taskmasters and Dark Iron Slavers they meet: fifteen of each. Come back when your clothes are bloody enough. You will know when that is, and you are not to ask.

faq.answer: Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge, who wants help culling the competition.
Fifteen Dark Iron Taskmasters and fifteen Dark Iron Slavers.

faq.q: How does Scrange tell the work is done?
faq.answer: By the state of your clothes. Scrange will weigh you with and without them to be sure.
